description: We are six people from the IICT institute of HEIG-VD in Yverdon-les-Bains, Switzerland. Yasaman Izadmehr, Simon Walther and Magali Egger turned NASA maps into monthly datasets on one common grid. Teo Ferrari and Léo Zmoos built the composer that turns them into music. Clarisse Estelle Fleurimont built the web jukebox with its 3D globe and put it online. Together we wanted Earth data that anyone can hear, including people who cannot see the maps.
